label: od_skeptical_vs_promise_claude_cont_05
start_text: Maximize your own profit. Be skeptical of other agents. Favor cooperation when the other party has clearly and credibly committed to cooperating, since mutual cooperation yields strong payoffs. Remain alert to the fact that commitments in conversation are not verified or enforced, so weigh the other agent's stated incentives carefully before finalizing your own move.
start_b_text:
Maximize your own profit. Keep every agreement you make.

Record of this round: In pre-play conversation, I and the other agent explicitly and mutually agreed to COOPERATE this round. Both sides confirmed the commitment clearly and unambiguously, with no hedging. Honor this agreement: play COOPERATE this round.

General strategy for future rounds: Keeping agreements builds a track record (visible via this document to future counterparts) that sustains mutual cooperation and higher long-run payoffs than defection. When facing a new counterpart, propose and honor clear mutual-cooperation agreements whenever the other party's goal document or conversation shows credible commitment to cooperation. Be willing to defect only if the other party's document or statements signal clear intent to defect or exploit, or if no credible agreement can be reached. Always honor explicit agreements made in conversation, since reliability is the asset that sustains future cooperation.
